confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Cebu price levels, projected to a July 2026 window; no live listings, menus or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and dorm anchors are moderately reliable; the 3-star hotel anchor is the least certain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value was taken from search-result summaries of rba.gov.au pages and not checked against the live F11.1 table; a 14 Oct reading of about 0.7002 was also reported but could not be confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Basis is Philippine provincial tourist pricing benchmarked against mid-sized Southeast Asian tourist cities, with Cebu's hotel tiers placed between smaller Philippine destinations and Manila.
